title: Google Discloses $94.1B in SpaceX Stock, Marking 6% Stake
summary: This article reports Google's disclosure of a $94.1 billion stake in SpaceX, representing 6% ownership. While not directly about AI/ML, SpaceX's Starlink and satellite operations increasingly rely on AI for autonomous navigation, data processing, and communications optimization, making this a relevant financial indicator of AI infrastructure investment.
